reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically sound: larger particles have higher thermal and kinetic energy, leading to thicker splats and higher deposition efficiency, while the lower surface-to-volume ratio reduces oxidation, all consistent with thermal spray science.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements (thickness, oxidation, microstructure, adhesion) and a decisive falsification criterion based on thickness increase and coating quality.
reasons.usefulness: This is a direct, practical solution to the stated thickness shortfall, grounded in established mechanisms, and would be immediately useful to a researcher working on this problem.
